V20 - the hinged strips, one per side, each carrying both posts · pin at the front · fingerscrews come up through the BOTTOM - purple knobs underneath at the back (flip it over to see them) · canal walls opened up in one smooth curve · the centre top at the FRONT is taken down to the canal floor height, so the boss on the dish clears it when attaching · strips shown DOWN: posts flush, dish slides on and off · drag to spin · pinch to zoom · double-tap resets
SIZE KEY (mm) - tap to open
Bracket V20165.2 wide - the WHOLE top raised to the side walls height over its full length - canal down the middle, its walls opened up in one smooth curve - the centre strip at the front is taken back down to the canal floor height (the dish boss runs there when attaching), ramping back up behind the front posts - a channel in the top on each side for its strip - the screw housings underneath at the back add a small bump, 3 past the old outline
Strips (green)one per side, 36 wide x 56 long, sits in the channel - carries both posts - hinged at the front on the orange pin
Posts (blue)front and rear post on each strip - flush with the top while the strip is down; they rise into the dish when the strip is jacked up
Hinge pins (orange)one across the front of each strip - the strip rocks on it
Fingerscrews (purple)UNDER the back of the bracket - the knob hangs below, the screw comes up through the bottom and its tip bears on the underside of the strip - screw up to jack the strip up and clamp the dish; back it off and the strip drops so the dish slides free
Scale bar (gray)50.0 long x 10.0 tall mm
